glosses: crucifix (statue of Jesus on the cross)

examples.text: Was hast du denn Herrgott noch mal erwartet, was passieren würde?
examples.en: What on earth were you expecting to happen?

examples.text: Du sagst, du willst nach Boston? Warum in Herrgotts Namen willst du denn dahin?
examples.en: You say you want to go to Boston? Why in the world would you want to go there?
